about: The evangelium of the formulary “Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a town of Galilee called Nazareth, to a virgin betrothed to a man named Joseph, of the house of David, and the virgin’s name was Mary. And when the angel come to her, he said, Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women.
